context_requirements: Expression of ALOX5 and/or PTGS1 (or other lipoxygenase/COX isoforms) in the cell line
Intact apoptotic machinery (caspase-9/caspase-3) for the antiproliferative/apoptotic arm
Low baseline oxidative stress; response is more apparent when cells are challenged or have high arachidonic acid flux
Proliferating cells are more likely to show antiproliferative transcriptional changes
falsifiers: No change in any of the listed proximal or late genes at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine lines
Strong and consistent upregulation of proliferation genes (e.g., CCND1, MYC, PCNA) at 24 h
A pattern indistinguishable from generic vehicle or DMSO response across all lines
No dose-dependent or time-dependent transcriptional signature despite known ALOX5 expression

evidence.supports: LOX inhibitors (NDGA, Rev-5901, baicalein) inhibit proliferation and induce apoptosis in MCF-7 and MDA-MB-231 breast cancer cells via cytochrome c release, caspase-9/3/7 activation, PARP cleavage, Bcl-2/Mcl-1 down and Bax up.
Lipoxygenase inhibitor MK886 sensitizes human glioma cells to TRAIL-induced apoptosis by upregulating death receptor 5 and downregulating survivin.
5-LOX inhibitor zileuton protects neuronal cells from glutamate-induced ferroptosis and oxidative damage, decreasing ROS.
Zileuton induces COX-2 expression and PGE2 biosynthesis via PKC delta activation in cardiac myogenic cells.
Zileuton attenuates neuronal apoptosis after focal cerebral ischemia, with reduced caspase-1 mRNA.

changes: Removed BAX from late_up: PMID 12200139 reports increased Bax protein levels after LOX inhibition, but the abstract does not establish transcriptional upregulation; protein-level change is not sufficient to justify a transcriptional direction.

Removed PMAIP1 from late_up: no retrieved abstract supports NOXA/PMAIP1 induction by lipoxygenase inhibition; the apoptotic arm in PMID 12200139 is cytochrome c/caspase-9 dependent, not NOXA-dependent.
Removed BNIP3 and BNIP3L from late_up: no retrieved abstract links lipoxygenase inhibition to BNIP3/BNIP3L transcription; these are generic hypoxia/autophagy genes.
Removed SESN1 from late_up: no retrieved abstract supports SESN1 induction by lipoxygenase inhibition; it is a generic stress/p53 target gene.
Removed CHAC1 from late_up: no retrieved abstract supports CHAC1 induction by lipoxygenase inhibition; it is a generic ISR/oxidative-stress gene.
Removed TSC22D3 from late_up: no retrieved abstract supports GILZ induction by lipoxygenase inhibition; it is a generic glucocorticoid/stress-responsive gene.
Removed DNAJB1 and HSPA1A from late_up: no retrieved abstract supports HSP induction by lipoxygenase inhibition; these are generic heat-shock/proteostatic genes.
Removed XBP1 and HERPUD1 from late_up: no retrieved abstract supports UPR/ER-stress arm activation by lipoxygenase inhibition; these are generic ER-stress genes.
Removed TRIB3 from late_up: no retrieved abstract supports TRIB3 induction by lipoxygenase inhibition; it is a generic stress/ATF4 target.
Removed CDKN1A and GADD45A from late_up: no retrieved abstract supports p21/GADD45 induction by lipoxygenase inhibition; these are generic p53/DNA-damage response genes.
Removed HMOX1 from proximal_up: no retrieved abstract supports HMOX1 induction by lipoxygenase inhibition; it is a generic oxidative-stress/NRF2 gene.
Removed SQSTM1 from proximal_up: no retrieved abstract supports p62 induction by lipoxygenase inhibition; it is a generic autophagy/oxidative-stress gene.

Removed NFKBIA, IER3, EGR1, FOS, JUN, ATF5, DDIT4 from proximal_up: no retrieved abstract supports immediate-early or NF-kB/ISR gene induction by lipoxygenase inhibition; these are generic stress-response genes.

Removed PTGS2 from proximal_up: PMID 19781629 supports COX-2 induction by zileuton in cardiac myogenic cells, but this is a cell-type-specific off-target/PKC-delta effect, not a general proximal transcriptional consequence of lipoxygenase inhibition across the nine lines.

Removed CCND1, MYC, BCL2, BIRC5, CCNA2, CDK1, TOP2A, AURKA, PLK1 from proximal_down: PMID 12200139 and PMID 22962275 support antiproliferative/apoptotic effects, but the abstracts do not establish that these specific genes are transcriptionally downregulated at 6 h; Bcl-2/Mcl-1 changes are protein-level and survivin downregulation is protein-level.

Removed CCNB1, CCNB2, CDC20, BUB1B, MCM3, PCNA, E2F2, MYBL2, CDK4, CCNE2, STMN1, UBE2C, KIF20A from late_down: no retrieved abstract establishes transcriptional repression of these specific cell-cycle genes by lipoxygenase inhibition; the antiproliferative effect is supported only at the level of proliferation/apoptosis, not gene-specific transcription.

Changed kinetics from 'slow' to 'unknown': retrieved abstracts report apoptosis and COX-2 induction over hours to days, but none provides a 6 h vs 24 h transcriptional time course to justify a slow kinetic label.
Changed magnitude 6h from 'weak' to 'unknown': no retrieved abstract provides quantitative transcriptional magnitude at 6 h.
Changed magnitude 24h from 'moderate' to 'unknown': no retrieved abstract provides quantitative transcriptional magnitude at 24 h.

Changed line_response for MCF7 from 'strong' to 'moderate': PMID 12200139 shows LOX inhibitors inhibit proliferation and induce apoptosis in MCF-7, but the abstract does not compare response strength across lines or justify 'strong' relative to others.
Changed line_response for A375, A549, HCC515, HT29, PC3, VCAP from 'moderate' to 'unknown': no retrieved abstract provides line-specific transcriptional response data for these lines.
Changed line_response for HA1E and HEPG2 from 'weak' to 'unknown': no retrieved abstract provides line-specific transcriptional response data for these lines.

Changed confidence from 'low' to 'low': retained low confidence because the retrieved abstracts support antiproliferative/apoptotic and COX-2 induction effects but do not support the specific transcriptional signature, directions, kinetics, or line-specific magnitudes proposed.
